text: Jess has her driving test May 14, third attempt. She's properly nervous this time, says she freezes at roundabouts and her instructor keeps telling her to breathe. Her boyfriend Ryan is driving her to the centre and waiting in the car park. Text her good luck that morning and ring her the day after to see how it went. If she passes, maybe get her one of those keyrings.
Luca lives in Leith now, flat above a bakery. Works nights at the sorting office.
pick up dry cleaning thurs, renew car tax before the 31st, cancel the gym trial
Pooja got her A level results today. Straight As! Her mum cried apparently. Must send a card this week.

Zhang's audition for the conservatory is June 3rd. He's been practising six hours a day and says he can barely sleep. His sister Chen is flying in the day before to go with him. I should message him afterwards, whatever happens.
Jada works for the council in planning. Her husband Idris is a paramedic. Two kids, both at St Mary's.
So I was chatting to Joanna after choir and she mentioned her son is sitting his eleven plus on 9/12. She seems more stressed than he is, honestly. Remind me to ask her how he got on a week after.
Note to self: dentist moved to 10/28 at 8.40. Book the car in for MOT the same week if possible.
Sophie's theory test was cancelled because the centre flooded. She's rebooked for November 6th. Don't forget to wish her luck the night before.
Hadiza - Lagos originally, moved to Manchester at 12. Brother Bilal still lives out there. Teaches maths at the sixth form college.
lucy bar exam results come out dec 2, she's chill about it apparently lol. ask how it went
Shira and Juan both have their citizenship test on the same day, April 22. They've been quizzing each other over dinner every night. Would be nice to take them out for a drink afterwards.
Bilal Usman, aka Bil, runs the corner shop on Fairfield Rd with his dad. Lives above it.
Groceries, post the parcel back to the warehouse, and book flights for my trip on 12/19. Do it all before Friday.

Chen called. Failed his driving test again yesterday, clipped a kerb on the reversing bit. He's gutted, said it's the third fail and he's spent nearly two grand on lessons. His mum keeps saying just get the bus, which isn't helping. He wants to rebook for sometime in January. Should check in on him tomorrow and maybe offer to take him out practising on Sunday mornings.
Zoe's daughter has her grade 5 piano exam March 8. Zoe's been sitting in on every lesson. Don't think the kid is nervous at all.
Yetunde lives in Croydon with her partner Graham. He's an electrician, she's in HR at a bank. They have a greyhound called Biscuit.

Voice memo. Okay so Joseph's med school interview is on the 15th, actually wait, November 15th, and his results for the UCAT came back really good. He's worried about the MMI stations though. I need to send him those practice questions I mentioned, and text him the morning of to say good luck. Also his mum Marta said to come round for dinner the week after.
Marta's a nurse at the Royal, been there twenty years. Lives in Didsbury.
Caitlin passed! Her PhD viva was this morning, minor corrections only. Send congrats and maybe flowers.
need to sort the boiler service. also return library books, they were due 10/14 oops

Ava mentioned she's dreading her end of year exams, starts June 2nd, chemistry first which is the one she's worst at. Her dad's been on at her constantly about grades and she's barely eating. She said she'd rather just get it over with. Her friend Kavya is doing a revision group on Thursdays. Check in with her the weekend before, and maybe send a little care package the day of the first paper.
Arjun Singh, Ryan's cousin. Works at Deloitte in audit. Lives in Leicester with his parents, wants to move to London next year.
Ryan's got his black belt grading Saturday. Said he'd let me know how it goes the day after. Remind me to ask if he forgets.
Kavya's sister Divya sat her CPA exam on Sept 30 and is waiting on results. Kavya says she's been a wreck. I should message Divya when the results land, should be about four weeks after.
Dorota, upstairs neighbour, works from home doing translation. Polish, two cats, Kasia and Bartek. Her son lives in Gdańsk.
Oisín's band audition for the folk festival got pulled, organisers ran out of funding. He's applying to busk at the market instead.
Divya - vegetarian, no mushrooms either. Lives in Bristol. Studies architecture at UWE.
Ben's hazard perception retest Tuesday. Then the practical on Dec 4. Text him after the first one.
Michael from work said his wife Joanna is expecting, due in March. Also he's got his chartered exam on Jan 12th, poor guy, terrible timing. Maybe chip in for a baby gift with the team.
Anil's retiring from the post office end of the month. Wife Pooja wants to do a surprise lunch the day after. I'm doing the cake.
Haircut 5/9, 2pm. Need to call the bank about the card too.
Jess's little brother Arjun got into the grammar school! Results came this morning. Jess was buzzing.

Talked to Luca re his dad - had a scan on Monday, they're getting results the following week. Luca's not sleeping, keeps googling things at 3am. His sister Marta is driving down from Leeds for the appointment so at least he won't be on his own. He also mentioned his own probation review at work got pushed to the week after, so a lot on. Must call him on Friday.
Pooja hints she wants a proper fountain pen for after her exams. Her finals finish July 1st. Could be a nice congrats present.
Idris - paramedic, works out of the Hillside station. Allergic to penicillin. Plays five a side on Weds.
Shira mentioned her mum's had a fall and is in hospital, hip op on the 23rd. Shira's going up the day before to be with her. Text her that evening to see how it went.

Juan's sitting the DELE C1 on 11/18 in London, the oral part is the day after. Says he's fine but he's revised every night for months, and Shira says he talks Spanish in his sleep now. If he passes he can apply for the teaching job in Valencia. He's staying with his cousin Luca in Brixton for the two days.
Jada and Idris took their son to his first swimming gala, he came second in breaststroke. They're thrilled.
Graham's driving instructor, apparently. Not an electrician, my mistake earlier. Works for himself, lives out in Sutton now.
Bilal's niece is doing her GCSEs next summer and wants maths tutoring. I said I'd think about it. Need to get back to him by the end of the week.

Dictated. Errands for Saturday. Drop the bike at the shop in the morning, they said the gears need a full service and maybe new brake pads. Farmers market for eggs and that sourdough. Buy stamps and post the birthday cards. Get the car washed. Pick the bike up afterwards if it's ready, otherwise Monday after work. And book the tip slot for Sunday for the old desk.
Zoe Hughes, Zo to everyone, moved to Brighton last spring. Works at the uni library. Her partner's a chef.
Hadiza's driving test went well! Passed first time on Tuesday. Bilal says she wants a little second hand Fiat now.

Caitlin's brother Oisín has his grade 8 violin exam May 20. She said he's terrified. Remind me to text Caitlin the day before so she can pass on good luck, and then ask about results a few weeks after.
Joseph lives with his gran in Harrow. Mum Marta, dad works abroad, Dubai I think.
Ava's dog Mochi has his operation on the 3rd, knee ligament. She's taking the whole day off. Message her that afternoon.
Arjun failed his first ACCA paper, resitting on 3/10. He seemed a bit down about it but said he knows what went wrong.

Kavya, old uni friend from Leeds. Lives in Hackney, in a two bed above a launderette, works in product at Monzo. Married to Ben, who's a secondary school PE teacher. They have a toddler called Ava and a very old cat called Pickle. Her parents live in Leicester and her brother Anil is a GP in Nottingham. Vegan for years.
Book eye test. Order contact lenses. Pay the window cleaner.

Long call with Dorota. Her granddaughter Lucy has her matura exams starting May 5 back in Poland and Dorota's flying out the day before the last one, May 19, to take her out to celebrate afterwards. She asked if I'd water the cats' plants. Also Dorota had her own cataract op last week, recovering fine, eye drops four times a day. Need to pop up on Thursday to get the spare key.

Michael passed his chartered exam, despite everything. Says he revised mostly at 5am before Joanna woke up. Results came out Thursday and his boss already mentioned a pay bump in the new year. Baby's due in about six weeks and they still haven't finished the nursery. Send a congrats message, and sort the team collection for the baby gift before he goes on paternity leave.
Lucy said Ben and Kavya are doing a cookery course together starting Jan 8, Thai food. Kavya wants a decent wok apparently.
ryan's mum - Mrs Smith - teaches piano, lives on Elm Grove. ryan says she's having a knee op 12/1
Anil said his granddaughter Jess is sitting her driving theory next week, then her practical a month after if she passes. He's teaching her in his old Volvo.
Nothing major. Picked up the prescription, paid council tax, sorted the recycling.
Chen's actually passed! Retook the test on Friday, examiner said it was a textbook drive. He's already planning a road trip with Zhang in the summer. Get him a card and those silly fluffy dice.
Sophie Olsen - Danish, lives in Glasgow, works as a sound engineer at the BBC. Partner Yetunde? No, different Yetunde. Never mind.
Ask Pooja how her finals went, she finished July 1st and I never followed up. Feel bad.
Joanna's son passed the eleven plus! Offer from Tiffin. She's over the moon. Her husband Anil is planning a little party on Oct 26th, we're invited.
